description: Zhuge Liang, slender chinese strategist in the supplied pixel art style. Tall dark blue scholar's hat with a small white jewel, long cream-white robe with wide hanging sleeves, pale green trim, a green sash tied at the waist with long ends hanging down the front, white shoes. He holds a white crane-feather fan in the right hand
face: Calm narrow eyes, thin black moustache and a small pointed black beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the back of the tall dark blue hat with black hair under it, the plain cream robe with a green sash across the back and its ends hanging down, wide sleeves at both sides. The fan is in front of the body and mostly hidden.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the feather fan up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the feather fan up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, fan held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Upward flick of the fan. Frames 3-6 the knees bend and the fan is lowered in front; frames 7-8 the body straightens up tall and the fan is flicked from below to high above the head; frames 9-11 hold with the fan high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The fan keeps its size and shape and stays in the right hand
actions.a2: Open-palm push. The fan stays at his right side. Frames 3-6 he draws the empty LEFT hand back; frames 7-8 he turns his left shoulder forward, standing side-on, and pushes the open left palm straight out in front; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The fan keeps its size and shape and stays in the right hand
actions.b2: Downward stroke of the fan. Frames 3-6 he stands tall and raises the fan above his head; frames 7-8 he drops into a deep knee bend and draws the fan straight down in front; frames 9-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The fan keeps its size and shape and stays in the right hand
actions.s1: Grand stratagem. Frames 3-6 he sinks low and winds back, fan gathered down beside the right hip; frame 7 the left foot steps forward; frame 8 he sweeps the fan forward and up in one large commanding gesture, arm fully extended; frames 9-12 hold the pose. Frames 13-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The fan keeps its size and shape and stays in the right hand
actions.a3: Wide sweeping release. Frames 3-6 the  is wound to the left chest; frame 7 the left foot steps out; frame 8 it is swept wide to the right; frames 9-11 hold.

notes: 2026-11-19. 평타 b1(올려 튕기기) → a2(빈손 밀기) → b2(내려 긋기), 전법 s1(대계). 부채 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 후면은 몸에 가려 추정. 날리는 천은 긴 소매 둘과 도포 자락.
